Global20/20 floor exists, but authorized_experiment does not recheck class support inside each fold. Existing group-label shuffle cycles unequal-length vectors and may change class counts. New runner needs fold admission and an explicitly specified permutation control before fitting.

factorization.principle: Separate turn purpose, candidate linguistic closure, semantic use, value resolution and target/reference binding. Share a deterministic extractor only; initially independent binary linear models. No completion=>primary, primary-negative=>consent, or score=>permission implication.

union_algorithm: Build a disjoint-set over complete ancestry before feature/label masking: shared original root, aliases, paraphrase/contrast family, carrier/template skeleton and exact/near duplicate reviewed source lineage produce union edges. Keep reviewers of one row together; reviewer independence is not source independence.

Resolve cross-corpus aliases to transitive closure. Masked descendants still connect lineage. Do not split one canonical family to increase support. Quarantine unresolved alias links from fitting until closed, rather than claiming separation.

Freeze a union manifest with every included/excluded member, reason, source hashes and canonical ID. Put all members of a group in one fold, across all heads. No global vocabulary, feature selection, learned normalizer, calibration fit or distillation targets built from held-out members.
Apply actual runtime source/privacy/candidate/axis masks to closed groups. Recount support after masking; annotation nomination totals are not support.

Do not union an entire author solely for sharing authorship in the ordinary root split; authorship is a separate domain variable. For an author-held-out claim, embargo all roots and all cross-author connected aliases touched by that held-out author. A single-author corpus cannot measure author transfer.
source_union_and_admission.sets: For head h and fit subset T: P_h(T)={canonical g with eligible y=1 in T}; N_h(T)={g with eligible y=0}; M_h=P_h intersect N_h. Primary additional negatives A_h=N_h minus P_h. DATE permits paired groups in P and N but effective independent size is |P union N|, not |P|+|N|.
source_union_and_admission.global_gate: Primary |P|>=20 and |A|>=20. DATE |P|>=20 and |N|>=20. These are engineering data floors, not independent gold, guaranteed learnability or safety certification.
source_union_and_admission.fit_gate: Repeat the same head-specific gate on each actual training subset, including every OOF/inner/ablation fit. Full-data support20 may become16 in a 5-fold fit. Do not silently relax, bypass via a lower-level fit(), or hide unsupported folds.
source_union_and_admission.balanced_five_fold_sufficient_condition: For a class supported on n groups with near-even partition, n-ceil(n/5)>=20. n=25 suffices, n=24 leaves19 in at least one fold. Primary needs25 positive and25 additional-negative groups for this sufficient construction; DATE can use25 paired groups supporting both classes. Actual group constraints, source embargoes and class overlap still require the full fold matrix.
source_union_and_admission.general_condition: For every fold k, n_class - support_removed_by_fold_k >=20; recompute additional-negative classification from full eligible member sets after whole-group removal. For leave-one-group-out,21 groups per required class suffice in the favorable case, but runtime/fits may exceed the authorized CPU budget.
source_union_and_admission.fold_choice: Use the existing predeclared fold assignment if authorization requires it. Any prospective replacement must be chosen before model results, frozen with source closure and newly authorized; label-stratified fold balancing is disclosed development design. Do not seek a seed yielding better OOF scores.
source_union_and_admission.if_global_pass_fold_fail: Report full-fit eligible / OOF ineligible separately. Do not claim OOF evaluation. A full-data exploratory fit requires explicit appropriate authorization and has no generalization estimate; current plan prefers collection until the prescribed folds qualify.
source_union_and_admission.V6_current: Pending actual adjudication, union closure and feature masks. Neither 132 rows nor 264 reviews prove any class floor. V5 support remains the last verified NO-FIT baseline.

training_objective.model: Two independent regularized binary logistic regressions over frozen sparse features; no shared learned representation or old weights. BCE uses stable softplus(z)-y*z. Fresh weights and bias initialized to0.
training_objective.mask: For each head, use only m_h=1 examples. No loss for missing labels; no label inferred from another head, detector flag, model score or downstream bank result.
training_objective.weighting: L_h = (1/|G_h|) sum_g (1/|R_gh|) sum_r (1/|C_grh|) sum_i_in_C_grh BCE(y_i,z_i) + lambda_h/2 * ||w_h||^2. R_gh are eligible turns in group, C_grh eligible head instances in turn. Primary has one instance per turn. This prevents long groups or turns with many candidates from dominating.
training_objective.multihead: Independent parameters minimize each L_h separately; a global reporting mean does not couple labels. If a later shared model is proposed, normalize each head loss first, predeclare coefficients and retest negative transfer. No such shared model admitted now.
training_objective.class_balance: Unweighted BCE within the group/turn/instance normalization is the baseline. Report group-conditioned class performance. Do not oversample aliases or copy rare labels to hit a floor. Class weighting/focal loss are separate preregistered variants, not an unreported fix.
training_objective.vocabulary: Select vocabulary from that fit TRAIN subset only, deterministically by frequency and lexicographic ties as frozen contract. Use identical runtime extraction and normalization; no oracle spans or full-corpus vocabulary. Keep caps1024 primary and384 DATE unless a new extractor is explicitly frozen.
training_objective.optimization: Preserve the exact authorized primary80-epoch/lr0.8/L2=0.0002 baseline. Proposed DATE pilot may use the same fixed settings after separate authorization; settings are a proposal, not a performed fit. All fits share the parent wall budget, with failure/timeout reported instead of partial cherry-picked results.
training_objective.uncertainty: Train semantic likelihood only. Abstention is a separate deterministic eligibility + later calibrated risk decision; do not train unknown as y0 or force incomplete candidates to predict primary unknown. Ambiguous labels remain masked and their frequency is reported.

before_fit: Freeze adjudicated source unions, masks, feature/candidate versions, head semantics, folds and one parent-authorized CPU run budget.
Predeclare all controls, metrics and minimum useful effect; reject unsupported folds before training.
Keep new DEV, risk and qualification sources unread. Current old DEV and OOF are exposed development diagnostics, never qualification.

controls.input: Only training-fold complete label vectors exchanged between distinct canonical groups within equal eligible-instance-count strata; deterministic member ordering frozen before labels are permuted. Preserve masks and count distribution; do not cycle unequal vectors.
controls.purpose: negative control, not a p-value test; disclose strata and fraction of groups actually moved. Singleton strata unchanged; if fewer than80% of eligible groups move, mark control weak and do not treat it as proof against leakage.

evaluation_plan.control_execution: All variants use the full model eligibility population, same folds and source embargo; ablations may remove features but cannot admit previously masked surfaces. Build each vocabulary within each training fold. Predeclare one control seed. No fits or controls executed in this checkpoint.
primary_metrics: group-macro BCE and Brier; group-macro accuracy at fixed logit0; per-class group-macro recall
paired per-canonical-group loss deltas vs each baseline; source/author/phase strata and top-group influence
eligible-row and group coverage plus all exclusion reasons; do not report eligible-only accuracy as whole-pipeline accuracy
date_metrics: maximal exact-candidate recall on independently reviewed temporal spans; false-candidate precision only on an exhaustively reviewed candidate/absent-region universe
completion error conditional on actual aligned eligible candidates; end-to-end failure including miss/misalignment/invalid candidate
per-root complete/unfinished recall, boundary/reference/vague/negated/scoped-correction contrasts where independently annotated
oracle-span comparison is a separate diagnostic upper pipeline comparison, never the deployed result or a replacement training input
evaluation_plan.aggregation: Pool one OOF prediction per eligible instance, aggregate within turn then root; weight roots equally, not folds equally. Report both class support and effective root count. Paired contrast members remain one root. Do not count rows, reviews, candidates or heads as independent samples.

benefit_rule_proposed_before_fit.engineering_screen: Default minimum useful group-macro BCE reduction0.02 nats versus the strongest preregistered control; no class group-recall decrease greater than0.02 absolute. Parent may choose a different practical margin only before fitting and record it. This is a development screen, not significance or qualification.
benefit_rule_proposed_before_fit.date_specific: Full DATE model must improve over syntax_only as well as constant/phase-only controls; otherwise a learned head has not shown value beyond its scanner. A head can remain useful with no context advantage, but then do not claim context learning; prefer the simpler text model and confirm the choice on new data.
benefit_rule_proposed_before_fit.uncertainty: Report complete per-root loss-difference distribution, leave-one-root influence and descriptive paired-root bootstrap intervals with fixed seed; overlapping-fold training and shared authorship prevent treating these intervals as IID certification. Improvement concentrated in one lineage or absent on a source-held-out stratum is insufficient for a generalization claim.
benefit_rule_proposed_before_fit.permutation: Strong shuffled-label performance triggers source/leakage investigation. Weak shuffled-label performance alone proves neither absence of leakage nor generalization.
benefit_rule_proposed_before_fit.selection: Choosing the best variant or threshold on these OOF results is adaptive development. Freeze the selected model and validate on genuinely new, independently authored/reviewed data before stronger claims. No GPU or production decision follows solely from passing this small-data screen.

evaluation_plan.source_independence: Two fresh model annotators can reveal disagreement but do not create human/IID truth. Source adjudication must preserve ambiguities; bank ledger correctness and policy authorization are separate evidence targets. Author-held-out evaluation needs actual multiple source authors, not reviewer identities.

order: Freeze extractor, label semantics, corpus unions and chosen model after development.
Collect separate new author/source groups for calibration-fit; use no reviewed development rows as newly blind.
Freeze calibration parameters and threshold before a separate risk-estimation set; if threshold is selected on risk data, require simultaneous bounds or new data.
Only after complete model/threshold/policy freeze admit a blind final qualification set. Any inspection used for tuning makes that set diagnostic and requires a new final set.
calibration_risk_OOD.accepted_group_error: For a specified semantic task and fixed acceptance rule, group error=1 if any accepted eligible prediction in that canonical group is wrong. Fix the rule for group coverage as at least one accepted prediction. Also report accepted instance coverage and fully-correct accepted-group coverage; do not hide detector or ingress exclusions.
calibration_risk_OOD.bounds: On genuinely independent groups under the stated sampling population, one-sided95% exact binomial upper U solves sum_{j=0}^{e} C(n,j) U^j (1-U)^(n-j)=0.05 for e<n; U=1 if e=n. n=0 is unestimable. For e=0, U=1-0.05^(1/n). Small authorship-correlated engineering sets do not justify this population claim; report it only as a conditional sample-size calculation.
calibration_risk_OOD.multiplicity: For M prespecified simultaneous risk statements use alpha/M or another valid preregistered simultaneous procedure. Head confidence minima are not a joint probability. Qualify the actual combined acceptance decision at root level; do not multiply scores or count correlated heads twice.
calibration_risk_OOD.OOD: Keep new author/template/phrase families, unseen context combinations, target/reference changes, and unsupported locale/security contexts separate. Unsupported input triggers masks; these are fail-closed tests, not examples to be recoded negative. Performance on supported unfamiliar wording needs a new source-disjoint sample. Synthetic fixture signatures never authorize runtime ingress.
calibration_risk_OOD.current: No calibration, risk, OOD or qualification performance claimed. All learned runtime decisions remain abstentions because current authoritative raw ingress is unavailable.

portable_CPU_contract.implementation: stdlib-only deterministic sparse extraction plus independent dot products and stable sigmoid. No remote inference, download, GPU, new platform tools, bank keys or tenant identifiers in weights/features.
inference_algorithm: Verify immutable bundle schema, feature/detector versions, finite coefficients, feature vocab uniqueness and per-head label semantics. Invalid or oversized bundles fail closed.
Validate independently bound source fixture for offline use; distinguish real runtime_current_ingress_proven. Check privacy/security/framing/whole-scope limits before extracting any surface feature.
Run the exact frozen R4 scanner for DATE and preserve competing types. Reject overflow/unsupported source; never truncate silently or turn missing candidates into negatives.

For each actual candidate apply its exact R4 window mask and axis-specific admission. Primary uses the whole bounded source independently. A masked DATE candidate does not mechanically erase an unrelated eligible primary diagnostic.
Score only trained matching heads. Emit uncalibrated sidecar scores and reason codes. Untrained axes remain unknown; no default financial values, consent flags or target assignment.

Emit unchanged neutral wire/all-abstain until a separately qualified runtime integration establishes source and policy dependencies. Even then suggestions pass checkpoint13 reducer and deterministic dispatch gates.

source_limits.locale: en; others unsupported under current R4

portable_CPU_contract.complexity: Two primary/DATE vocabularies total1408 coefficients plus2 biases. At most1024 primary and16*384 DATE multiply-adds per eligible turn, excluding bounded extraction. These operation counts are design limits, not measured latency. R4 scanner still runs over its bounded source; report actual full-pipeline latency.

export.accounting: Sum all files required for deployed scoring: runtime source, vocabularies, weights, decoder, metadata/manifests. Count packaged representation and report decoded resident memory separately; no uncounted encoder or inherited large model. File overhead counted by actual byte length.
export.proposed_storage: Deduplicated vocabulary arrays and float64 weights packed with stdlib struct/base64 preserve IEEE coefficient values; or compact JSON if actual size fits. Packaging adapter needs parity; no silent float32 quantization.
export.budget_status: Illustrative engineering allocation, not measured implementation size. Any actual subtotal over cap blocks export; do not truncate vocabulary/inputs or remove masks to force a pass.

cold start and warm p50/p95/p99 full-pipeline latency on named CPU, fixed adversarial bounded inputs and actual eligible TRAIN fixtures; repeat counts disclosed
peak process RSS and decoded bundle memory
native/export exact feature, mask, proposed-label, reason and neutral-wire parity; numerical logits tolerance pinned before run
schema, nonfinite, Unicode offsets, longest permitted turn-ID, empty/missing revision and overflow failure tests
portable_CPU_contract.quality_gate: Size/latency/parity success is implementation evidence only. It cannot substitute for label adequacy, semantic accuracy, policy compliance or independent qualification.
portable_CPU_contract.GPU_gate: No GPU need established. First measure whether CPU error is a representation bottleneck rather than detector/privacy/label/ingress failure. A future frozen encoder comparator must show source-disjoint benefit under equal data/feature controls, followed by actual student parity/quality and audited adapter plus real parent grant. H100 availability and mock success alone justify no cloud job.

minimal_V6_handoff_metrics.request: Adjudication/closure status and manifest hashes; exact source union digest, rows and canonical roots by source family. Unresolved aliases/ambiguities excluded with counts. No row wording/labels/predictions needed by designer.

Per-head cumulative AND-mask funnel and mutually exclusive first-failure counts: source/framing/privacy, actual detector, maximal alignment, candidate-kind/target-scope, axis ambiguity, feature cap and lineage. Report both rows/candidates and canonical groups.
After all masks: |P|, |N|, |P intersect N|, |N minus P|, |P union N| for each head. Distinguish V5 frozen baseline from newly admitted V6.132 authored/reviewed rows is not an admitted count.

Exact fold manifest and each fold train/test support matrix for each head; duplicates/cross-source aliases crossing folds must be0. State global-pass and every-fit-pass separately. Include masked descendants in union audit.
Actual extractor/scanner/window/feature-mask hashes and versions, admitted CPU authorization digest and allowed heads, zero-init/reuse status. PRE-ADJUD extraction is not fit authorization.

DATE detector: reviewed maximal spans, exact matches, boundary mismatches, misses, false candidates and unreviewed candidate regions; count groups and explain target-unknown exclusions without changing supervision.
Directly annotated subclass/presence/polarity/reference/value axes available vs missing; no inference from binary primary or completion labels. Report whether the two pilots alone are supportable.

Only after authorization/gates: run manifest, fit counts/elapsed/timeout, aggregate root-level BCE/Brier/class recall and paired control deltas, moved-group fraction for permutation. Mark all OOF selection exploratory; do not send DEV or row predictions to this checkpoint.
Actual export bytes, memory, latency and feature/mask/export parity; current ingress qualification=false and runtime all-abstain retained. Report no-fit plainly if any required gate fails.

handoff_order: Close adjudication and canonical union; produce M01-M07 without fitting.
Check global and every-fit admission. If blocked, nominate genuinely new missing-support roots for independent review; no alias inflation or mask relabeling.
Freeze budgeted control plan and obtain exact parent CPU authorization for the admitted heads.
Run bounded CPU pilots and controls only after gates; report M08-M09.
Choose next data/representation question from actual errors; keep calibration/risk/qualification independent and future.
admission_pseudocode: closure = union_complete_source_ancestry(all_packet_members, alias_edges, contrast_edges, duplicate_edges); reject unresolved closure
freeze(closure, input_hashes, exact_feature_versions, axis_schema, folds, control_plan)
eligible = [actual_instance for actual_instance in actual_pipeline if conjunction_of_head_masks(actual_instance)]
fit_rows = eligible whose canonical_root not in heldout_roots[fold]
test_rows = eligible whose canonical_root in heldout_roots[fold]
fold_status[head,fold] = support_gate(head,fit_rows) and nonempty(test_rows) and no_source_union_overlap
fit_admitted[head] = global_status[head] and all(fold_status[head,*]) and exact_parent_authorization(head, hashes, budget)

norm_and_control_details.frozen_normalization: Primary V5 and DATE R4 L2-normalize the full extracted feature map before vocabulary restriction. Preserve this ordering in TRAIN, native scorer and export; do not silently renormalize after restricting vocabulary.
norm_and_control_details.new_ablations: Construct the declared allowed feature blocks, L2-normalize that ablated map, then restrict to its training-fold vocabulary. Frozen existing modes retain their exact extractor behavior. Ablation view is pinned in the control manifest; eligibility always comes from the full contract first.
norm_and_control_details.shuffle_definition: Within each training fold and each eligible-instance-count stratum, choose one seeded permutation of canonical group label vectors. The vector includes labels only, not new masks or donor features. Canonical member ordering must be stable source-member IDs, never sorted by label. Record fixed points and class counts before/after. Unequal vector lengths never cycled.
norm_and_control_details.candidate_dependency: Shared syntax indicators can be useful features, but independent reviewers must label source semantics without seeing scanner output. Alignment occurs afterward. Candidate-boundary truth cannot be established by asking the same scanner to validate itself.

verification.kind: artifact consistency and specification arithmetic only
verification.warning: None of these checks measures model quality, source independence, calibration, generalization, bank correctness or hosted performance.
